experts_subtitle: Chat with our team of virtual experts for personalized advice.
expert_desc_nutritionist: Specialized in personalized nutrition. I can help you create meal plans tailored to your goals and restrictions.
expert_prompt_nutritionist: Ask me a question about your diet...
expert_response_nutritionist_1: Based on your profile, I recommend focusing on lean proteins like grilled chicken or fish. For a healthy snack, try a mix of nuts and dried fruits.
expert_response_nutritionist_2: For someone of your age and with your BMI, I suggest steaming or baking to preserve nutrients. Use fresh herbs to season without adding salt.
expert_response_nutritionist_3: Colorful vegetables like spinach, carrots, and peppers are excellent for your health. Try to include them in every meal for a variety of vitamins.
expert_desc_coach: Fitness and performance expert. I design exercise programs for all levels, from weight loss to muscle building.
expert_response_coach_1: For someone with your BMI and health conditions, I recommend starting with 30 minutes of brisk walking 5 days a week, then gradually increasing intensity.
expert_response_coach_2: Resistance exercises like squats and push-ups are excellent for improving your strength and metabolism. Start with 2 sets of 10 repetitions.
expert_response_coach_3: To manage your diabetes and hypertension, focus on moderate cardiovascular exercises like swimming or stationary biking.
expert_desc_chef: Master of healthy flavors. Let's transform your ingredients into delicious and nutritious dishes. Ask me for a recipe!
expert_response_chef_1: With these ingredients, I can suggest a quinoa salad with grilled vegetables. Cook the quinoa, grill the vegetables, add a light vinaigrette with olive oil and lemon.
expert_response_chef_2: For a comforting and healthy dish, try a vegetable curry with coconut milk. Use spices like turmeric, cumin, and coriander for more flavor.
expert_response_chef_3: Here's an idea for a balanced breakfast: oatmeal with berries, chia seeds, and a little honey. This will give you energy for the day.
expert_default_response: Thank you for your question. As an AI expert, I can help you with personalized advice. Can you give me more details?
